citations.claim_text: Canonical Korvold and RogShai deck files were not modified by package extraction.
No real local Commander games have been imported into the learning layer.
The three opponent ensembles are unweighted because no real games are available for observational weighting.
Opponent ensemble variants do not infer complete decklists or confirm assumed cards.
Generated Mulligan keep rules are model-based and not absolute.
Counterfactual results are model alternatives rather than historical facts.
The integrated ten-extension smoke completed all ten steps with explicit validation levels.
Mulligan follow-ups and primary/holdout/ensemble/multi-pilot validations were executed as Structural model runs.
Counterfactual outputs contain explicit state differences and preserve the Structural/Tactical/external validation boundary.
The ten-step smoke executed every stage and diagnostics were derived from event logs.
